finding.headline: "The Junk-Food Survivor"
finding.problem: "I know Indomie and Gala aren't feeding my body but I'm too tired to cook. I feel like a bad mother every time I open the wrapper."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 24-yr-old Nigerian mum in a busy household who, when starving, grabs Gala, Chin-Chin, Indomie or puff-puff because they're one-handed and instant — then feels guilty her milk is "junk."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Marketing angle — "Healthy Swaps for the Tired Mama: 20 Nigerian Snacks That Beat Gala & Indomie."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
